### **AI Use Cases:**

- [ ]  **Voice Note → Text Summary**

- [ ]  **Next Action Suggestions**
    - [ ]  After appointment completion
    - [ ]  AI analyzes notes and suggests follow-up tasks
    - [ ]  Pre-populates task templates
- [ ]  **Compliance Monitoring**
    - [ ]  AI scans notes for required elements
    - [ ]  Flags incomplete documentation
    - [ ]  Feeds "Missing Notes" compliance view
